values.binNote: Wave timing (first wave at 0.05s, last at 2.9s, spread of 2.85s over waves-1 intervals) is not present as a data value in the sheet; derived from the description's notes, not BaseChannelDuration=3.

mechanics.claim: The damage dealt by each wave is calculated when the wave reaches the target, not on cast.
mechanics.quote: The damage dealt by each wave of ''Bullet Time'' is calculated when the wave reaches the target.

mechanics.claim: Each wave fires 6 projectiles but a target can only be hit by one projectile per wave.
mechanics.quote: Targets cannot be damaged by more than one projectile per wave.

mechanics.claim: Each wave can independently critically strike.
mechanics.quote: Each wave is in a spread of 6 projectiles that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.

mechanics.claim: The channel can be interrupted by taking damage, attacking, moving, using items, or using other spells.
The unusually short cast time gives an effective cast time longer than 0.001, waiting for the next game tick.
mechanics.quote: The unusually short [[cast time]] of ''Bullet Time'' will result in an effective cast time of {{rutngt|0.001}}, as the server must wait until the next game tick for the channel time to start.

mechanics.claim: Miss Fortune may cancel the last ~0.1 seconds of channel time without losing any effect.
mechanics.quote: '''Miss Fortune''' may cancel the last ~{{fd|0.1}} seconds of channel time at no loss of effect.
